name: Seeed XIAO ePaper EE03 (10.3" mono)
description: Seeed XIAO ePaper Display Board EE03 (XIAO ESP32-S3 Plus) driving the 10.3 inch monochrome panel (ED103TC2, 1872x1404) through the board's onboard IT8951E T-CON, with 16-level greyscale. Speaks Tesserae's v1 REST device API; server-side pack via esp32_gray_bin produces a raw 4-bpp linear grayscale buffer (1314144 bytes) the firmware streams straight into the IT8951's image buffer. Byte-identical wire contract to the Seeed reTerminal E1003, which productizes the same panel + controller combo. Reports battery percentage via the onboard ADC divider, carries the refresh/left/right three-button set like the EE02/EE04 boards, and has an onboard SHT40 temperature/humidity sensor; no touch overlay and no microSD slot.
notes_md: Awaiting confirmed test on real hardware. Wire format is exactly 1314144 bytes (1872*1404/2), row-major, top-left origin, no mirror. Per byte: high nibble = LEFT pixel, low nibble = RIGHT pixel; nibble value 0x0 = black, 0xF = white, linear 16-level grayscale. Byte-identical to the seeed_reterminal_e1003 target (same ED103TC2 glass behind the same IT8951 controller), so validate cross-panel by pointing the same renderer output at both. The firmware compensates for the panel's physical X-mirror on-device; the renderer keeps a normal orientation so a browser preview and the panel paint agree. auto_select is off: relay pairing must not infer this kind over the E1003's (identical protocol/gamut/geometry, but a kind names an OTA lineage); EE03 units declare their kind themselves at registration.
